summary: Regression verified after lazy-init refactor (get_db(), lazy reportlab & resend imports). Import-time check confirms server module import opens no MongoDB connection and does not import reportlab/resend (server._mongo_client, server._mongo_db, sys.modules['reportlab'], sys.modules['resend'] all None/absent right after `import server`). Full backend pytest suite: 35/35 passed (test_pontiscore_api, test_rgpd, test_pdf_smoke, test_editorial_pt, backend_test). Frontend e2e via public URL: Landing -> /diagnostico (10x Sim auto-advance) -> /resultado/:id dashboard renders (score 100, all pillars, strengths card) -> lead form (data-testids present) -> privacy checkbox ticked -> submit -> /obrigado. No console errors, no pageerrors. RESEND_API_KEY='CHANGE_ME' correctly treated as unset by _resend_api_key() (only 're_' prefixed keys accepted) so no Resend call is attempted and no error stack traces are logged — improvement over iteration_4 concern.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers (repeat from iteration_3/4, non-blocking).

Lazy-init is correctly implemented: get_db() memoizes the AsyncIOMotorClient; reportlab is imported inside build_pdf(); resend is imported inside send_lead_emails(); _resend_api_key() gates on 're_' prefix so placeholders like 'CHANGE_ME' skip email entirely. Good pattern for the cPanel/Passenger RecursionError-at-startup scenario.
shutdown handler correctly closes the client only if it was created — no side effects when no request ever hit the DB.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_-prefixed diagnostics and leads created during pytest run + one Playwright lead (TEST Playwright / TEST Co / test@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lazy-init refactor is verified end-to-end. Importing /app/backend/server.py performs no I/O and no heavy imports. All 35 backend tests + full frontend e2e (diagnóstico -> resultado -> lead -> obrigado) pass on the preview URL. RESEND_API_KEY='CHANGE_ME' is now silently treated as not configured (email_sent=false, no stack traces).
rca of the issue: N/A — regression verification only. Original PTISP RecursionError was addressed in prior iterations (iterative PDF build, _to_plain sanitizer, try/except in create_lead). This iteration confirms the additional import-time hardening (lazy DB connect + lazy reportlab/resend imports) preserves all functionality without opening sockets or importing heavy modules at import time.
